svg.title: gh-aw: your Pydantic AI agent as a GitHub Agentic Workflow
svg.desc: A new issue triggers the compiled gh-aw workflow. Its agent job runs the pydantic-ai engine in a container behind an egress firewall: the engine starts clai2 with your agent, named by PAI_AGENT, plus the workflow model and prompt. Model requests go through gh-aw's api-proxy, which holds the provider key, and the agent's GitHub and safe-output tools, such as github_issue_read and safeoutputs_add_comment, come from gh-aw's MCP gateway. After a threat-detection job checks the output, a separate add-comment job posts the comment with its own token.
